facts.text: As part of the Alma Commitment, every Alma College student qualifies for up to $2,500 through the Alma Venture grant program to offset costs for an experiential learning opportunity like an internship, fellowship, or study abroad.

sources.title: Alma Commitment at Alma College: Your Success is Our Promise
sources.quote: The Alma Venture program or other college-sponsored grant programs will provide up to $2,500 to offset the cost of your personalized experience.
